title: Yes Bank First Business credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A Yes First Business card crafted for corporate users, providing rewards on travel and business transactions, expense management tools, and milestone vouchers.

items.child: Coverage of up to Rs 8 lakhs for accidental death of the primary cardholder and lost card liability protection of up to Rs 8 lakhs.

benefitRows.name: Golf
benefitRows.offer: Get one complimentary golf lesson every calendar month and up to four green fee waived golf sessions at select golf courses across India.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Access the designated golf booking portal using the email ID registered with your credit card. Choose your preferred golf course, date, and time, and complete the booking. You’ll receive a confirmation via email, take this with you when you play. Note that additional costs like caddy fees and carts are usually not covered and must be paid at the course.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.description: Coverage of up to Rs 8 lakhs for accidental death of the primary cardholder and lost card liability protection of up to Rs 8 lakhs.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Report the incident to YES BANK Customer Care at 1800 103 6000 or 022 4935 0000. For email support, contact yesfirstcc@yesbank.in.
